column1: # The next-word tokenizer's cases, shared by the keyboard (NextWordText in NextWordModel.kt, run by
# tool/next_word_check.sh) and the starter tables' generator (tool/next_words.py --selftest), so the two cannot drift.
# Tab-separated: the language (its joiners, locale and sentence ends), 1 where the text is a full window (its start is
# no sentence start and its first word may be cut), the text before the cursor, then what is expected of it:
#   place     prev2|prev|typing   the context there and the word being typed; - where nothing may be predicted
#   finished  prev2|prev|word|shown   the last word something follows, as it would be learned; - where none is
# ~ is "no word", ^ a sentence start. \n is a new line and \u200c a half-space. An empty shown: the casing says nothing.
